title.en: hong kong museum festival, fun day at the museum of history.
title.de: hongkonger museumsfestival, fun day im museum of history.
title.tr: hong kong müze festivali, museum of history fun day'de.

line.en: the museum festival runs to 30 november, and the museum of history holds its fun day on saturday. the festival hours are 11:00 to 18:00, so it fits an afternoon in tsim sha tsui.
line.de: das museumsfestival läuft bis 30. november, und das museum of history veranstaltet am samstag seinen fun day. die festivalzeiten sind 11:00 bis 18:00, also passt es gut in einen nachmittag in tsim sha tsui.
line.tr: müze festivali 30 kasım'a kadar sürüyor ve museum of history cumartesi günü fun day düzenliyor. festival saatleri 11:00 ile 18:00 arası; tsim sha tsui'de bir öğleden sonraya uygun.

place.en: museum of history, tsim sha tsui
place.de: museum of history, tsim sha tsui
place.tr: museum of history, tsim sha tsui

sparks.why: Hong Kong Museum of History Fun Day on sat 7.11 listed by The Beat Hong Kong (Best Events, 2-8 Nov); festival dates and 11:00-18:00 hours from a Hong Kong Museum Festival 2026 listing. Festival programme itself to be checked on the official site.
